Systematic terminology-bank drift across the Urdu unit: prose uses سلوکیات (bank: طرزِ عمل پسندی), تعمیدیت/تعمیدی (bank: تعمیریت; تعمید = baptism, apparent misspelling), باوری تعمیر (bank: معاونتی تدریس) and قریبی نشوونما کا علاقہ (bank: علاقہ ہائے قربی نشوونما). The index key_terms block itself encodes سلوکیات for Behaviorism. The Urdu teacher notes cite the bank terms as the unit key terms, so the mismatch is reader-visible, and the bound concept graph (specs/content/efmp-301/concepts/unit-03.md) uses bank terms plus yet other variants (سکیماں، تعدیل، وکالی تقویت، منزلیں، مراحل کا سلسلہ), leaving three governance surfaces in disagreement. Repair: align the Urdu prose (and key_terms block) to the frozen bank, and reconcile the concept-graph authored labels with whatever the owner confirms; propose any genuinely preferred alternatives (e.g. سلوکیات) to the owner as bank candidates rather than using them unilaterally.

Semantic inversion in topic-01 (i18n/ur/.../unit-03/topic-01.mdx, corridor-scene paragraph): EN "nobody can un-hear an association by being told to" is rendered "کوئی بھی بتائے جانے سے association کو نہیں سن سکتا" ("no one can hear the association by being told"), which garbles the key point that an established association cannot be undone by instruction (the reason telling pupils to relax is useless). Repair: e.g. "کسی کو بتا دینے سے سنی ہوئی وابستگی مٹ نہیں جاتی".

Garbled term in topic-01 (i18n/ur/.../unit-03/topic-01.mdx:42): "classroom management" is rendered "جماعت کی کاؤنٹرائزنگ" - not an Urdu word and not a recognizable transliteration of "management". Bank term: جماعتی انتظام. Repair: use the bank term.

Wrong word for salivation throughout topic-01 and fig-U3-1 labels: "رال" means resin; the Pavlov account reads "گھنٹی اکیلی کتوں میں رال پیدا کرنے لگی" (the bell began producing resin in the dogs). Correct term: لعاب / لعاب دہن (or منہ میں پانی). Repair in prose (topic-01.mdx:46,48) and both fig-U3-1 variants.

Instructional-sequence corruption in topic-02 (i18n/ur/.../unit-03/topic-02.mdx:60): EN "break the roti (enactive), draw the roti (iconic), write 1/2 (symbolic)" is rendered with "روٹی بنائیں (تصویری)" ("make the roti") for the iconic step, so the sequence reads break -> make -> write. The same sentence earlier correctly renders "a drawing of the roti" as "روٹی کی ڈرائنگ". Repair: "روٹی کی شکل بنائیں/روٹی بنائیں -> روٹی کی ڈرائنگ بنائیں (تصویری)".

Mistranslated technical term "spiral curriculum" as "مراحل کا نصاب" (curriculum of stages) in index.mdx outcome 3, topic-02.mdx:56 heading and :64, unit-assessment summary and RRQ-06/checklist, and teacher-notes sequencing row. The rendering loses the spiral (early intuitive form, later formal return) and collides with Piaget مراحل (stages) discussed in the same topic; the concept graph uses "مراحل کا سلسلہ" (chain of stages), a third variant. Repair: use one accurate term (e.g. "سیڑھی دار نصاب" or "چکر دار نصاب") consistently and align the concept-graph label.

Repair: e.g. "جن سے کبھی بات نہیں ہوئی دیکھنے والوں نے بھی کیوں سیکھا".
